## Episode Thesis

This is a Danish episode of the Store Penge podcast. Its guest is Flatpay co-founder and CEO Sander Janca-Jensen. Most of the episode covers fintech in Denmark: Flatpay's fast growth against Nets/Nexi, its aim to become a decacorn within three years, how hard early-stage capital is to raise in Europe, and an optional future IPO. Host Mikkel Rosenvold also makes a macro call: he thinks markets are too pessimistic about French assets ahead of the April 2027 presidential election, and he sees a buying opportunity there. No listed Nordic small or mid-cap stock gets an explicit buy or sell view.
